jobs.notes: Open-market graduate applications open 9:00am AEST Monday 22 February 2027 and close 11:59pm AEST Sunday 4 April 2027, with interviews from 27 April 2027 and offers from 9:00am 2 June 2027; applies to all participating NSW firms and organisations.

Firm's own careers page confirms Sydney clerkship applications open 9:00am Wednesday 9 June 2027 and close 11:59pm Sunday 11 July 2027 (offers 8 September 2027), open to penultimate-year students in the defendant insurance team; the firm states Brisbane, Melbourne and Hobart 2027 dates are still to be released.

Firm's careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but gives only the month — no exact open or close date is published yet, so both are left null rather than guessed from state scheme dates.
